# BTree Systems

> BTree Systems is an IT and software training institute in Perungudi, Chennai, India, operating since 2011. It runs live, trainer-led classroom and online courses in Python full stack, Java full stack, AWS, DevOps, data analytics, software testing and UI/UX design, with real projects, certification and placement support.

## Key facts
- Location: Greeta Techpark, Gate 5, 96, VSI Functional Industrial Estate, Perungudi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600096, India
- Formats: live online batches and classroom batches in Chennai; weekday, weekend and fast-track timings; sessions are recorded
- Included with every course: 4-6 portfolio projects, a course certificate, vendor-exam preparation where one exists (AWS, Azure, ISTQB), and placement support (resume review, mock interviews, hiring-partner referrals)
- Contact: info@btreesystems.com, +91 91769 97676, WhatsApp +91 73973 93335

- [Microsoft Azure](https://btreesystems.com/courses/microsoft-azure): 2.5 months. AZ-104 administration with real deployments.

- [Data Analytics](https://btreesystems.com/courses/data-analytics): 3 months. Excel, SQL, Power BI and Python for analysis.
- [Data Science & ML](https://btreesystems.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning): 5 months. Python, statistics, machine learning and deployment.
- [Generative AI](https://btreesystems.com/courses/generative-ai): 2 months. LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and AI apps.
- [Software Testing](https://btreesystems.com/courses/software-testing): 3 months. Manual testing, Selenium with Java and API testing.
- [Playwright Automation](https://btreesystems.com/courses/playwright-automation): 2 months. Modern test automation with TypeScript.
- [UI/UX Design](https://btreesystems.com/courses/ui-ux-design): 3 months. Research, Figma and a case-study portfolio.
- [CCNA & CCNP](https://btreesystems.com/courses/ccna-ccnp): 4 months. Cisco routing, switching, security and automation labs.
- [Cyber Security](https://btreesystems.com/courses/cyber-security): 5 months. Ethical hacking, SOC and SIEM, web app and cloud security.
- [Azure DevOps](https://btreesystems.com/courses/azure-devops): 3 months. Azure Pipelines, Repos, Docker, AKS, Terraform and Bicep.
- [AWS Data Engineering](https://btreesystems.com/courses/aws-data-engineering): 4 months. SQL, PySpark, S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena and Kinesis.
- [Azure Data Engineering](https://btreesystems.com/courses/azure-data-engineering): 4 months. Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark and Microsoft Fabric.
- [GCP Data Engineering](https://btreesystems.com/courses/gcp-data-engineering): 4 months. BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc and Composer.
- [Microsoft Power Automate](https://btreesystems.com/courses/power-automate): 2 months. Cloud flows, desktop RPA, AI Builder and Copilot.
